answer: With a Documentation page approved in peer review backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The record keeps every ocean visible, so anyone can audit the work log. The garden marks the start and the haven the end, yet the claim is checked again at both points.
